structuredContent.body:
A parent that failed after awaiting a child retained its old current wait in run records, REST and MCP. Both the live failure transition and recovery from an already committed failure event now clear that wait. Park, wake, child completion and failure history remain intact. Already-finalized historical rows are preserved; this change includes no migration or historical rewrite.

Closes #410.

Validation:

- The initial old-source run used an earlier test draft and failed both cases at the stale-wait assertion. Independent review separately verified that the committed regressions fail with exact pre-fix failed-transition argument emulation and pass on the candidate; this probe is not a literal old-source rebuild. The candidate passes 197 focused tests and all 1,814 engine tests, with 96.94% line and 91.22% branch coverage. TypeScript, lint, formatting and diff checks pass. [Implementation evidence](docs/qa/2026-11-15-terminal-wait-implementation/README.md) · [Independent review and evidence qualification](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/487#issuecomment-6901983201)
- Independent native Windows QA passes W1–W4 on source `4e4501bd92953794bb733a746f7c24d1bcc2452a`: actual child failure, interruption after a committed failure event but before its projection, normal wait/success/cancel/authored-exit controls, and exact preservation of genuine finalized baseline history. SQL, REST get/list and compiled MCP get/list agree. Both native supervisor and wrapper exited 0; owned processes, listeners and run stores were cleaned up. [Candidate evidence](docs/qa/2026-11-15-terminal-wait-candidate/README.md)
- The current-main baseline reproduced both stale-wait paths. Its first fixture failure and reviewed seed-preparation correction remain recorded separately from the complete second baseline. The correction checkpointed only a verified copy of the closed synthetic database and compared the original run/event values. [Baseline evidence](docs/qa/2026-11-15-terminal-wait-baseline/README.md)

Current-head CI run [43758754651](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43758754651) passed: 9,607 tests passed / 41 skipped, 13 coverage packages above the line/branch floors, Browser 481 passed / 1 declared live-provider skip, Windows 14/14 and four template catalogs. The original Gates job hit its 30-minute limit; one unchanged-head Gates-only retry passed all 32 steps, while the three successful companion jobs were carried forward. [#488](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/488) retains the unresolved CI reliability follow-up. The high-severity audit threshold passed with 8 low / 13 moderate advisories; Windows uploaded no native artifact.

Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh returned [READY in scan 1](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/487#issuecomment-6901983201), with no product correction required. Fresh GPT-6 Astra max exact-head/target sign-off remains pending. The shared limit is three formal scans. No owner-only acceptance gate applies to #410. Other batch acceptance items remain separate.

This PR also archives the already-merged #381/#414 final CI and completion evidence for PR #485. Those records describe that earlier change and do not substitute for this PR's gates.
